on 10 June,
2024
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V. Shravan Kumar
 W.P. No.14174 of 2024
Order:

Heard the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the petitioner, the learned Government Pleader for Endowments for respondents No.1, 2 and 4 and the learned Government for Revenue for the respondent No.3 and perused the material made available on the record.
With their consent, the writ petition is disposed of at the threshold.

2. This writ petition has been filed by the Land Acquisition Officer, SRVR DLIS Project and Revenue Divisional Officer, Kalwakurthy, seeking to accord permission to acquire the proposed land to an extent of Ac.0.31 gts., in Sy.No.145/A2 situated at Mittasadagodu village, Vangoor Mandal,
Nagarkurnool District, Acs.1.22 gts., in Sy.No.28 situated at Dindi Chinthapally village, Vangoor Mandal, Narkurnool District, Acs.8.13 gts., in Sy.No.11; Ac.1.11 gts., in Sy.No.12; Acs.7.37 gts., in Sy.No.15; Acs.2.09 gts., in Sy.No.16; Acs.6.09 gts., in Sy.No.20; Ac.0.01 gts., in Sy.No.21; Acs.6.18 gts., in Sy.No.22; Acs.5.32 gts., in Sy.No.23; Acs.6.14 gts., in Sy.No.25; Acs.7.08 gts., in Sy.No.27 situated at Kamlapur village, Charkonda Mandal, Nagarkurnool District, and Acs.2.04 gts., in Sy.No.126; Ac.0.24 gts., in Sy.No.127/A, situated at Bhairapur village, Veldanda Mandal,
Nagarkurnool District, totally admeasuring an extent of NVSK, J Acs.56.33 gts., for the purpose of Excavation of main canal under Dindi Lift Irrigation Scheme.

3. When the matter has been taken up for hearing, the learned Government Pleader for Endowments has submitted that they have no-objection for acquisition of the subject land, provided necessary compensation is paid for the lands that are being acquired.

4. The learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the Revenue Division Officer, Kalwakurthy, i.e., petitioner herein submits that the officials will follow the procedure contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and only after paying the necessary compensation,
possession will be taken.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He would further submits that the subject matter of this writ petition is squarely covered by the order dated 05.03.2021 passed in W.P. No.1767 of 2021 by this Court.

5. In view of the above mentioned facts and circumstances and following the order dated 05.03.2021 passed in W.P. No.1767 of 2021 by this Court, this writ petition is allowed and permission is accorded to the petitioner-Revenue Divisional Officer, Kalwakurthy, to acquire the subject land,
strictly following the procedure contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
